name: Nicaragua (1896–1908)
description: Three equal horizontal stripes of light blue, white and light blue, with the coat of arms of the Greater Republic of Central America, a triangle with volcanoes within a wreath, in the centre.
history: Flag adopted in 1896 when Nicaragua joined Honduras and El Salvador in the Greater Republic of Central America (1896–1898), carrying that union's arms on the blue-white-blue triband; Nicaragua kept it after the union dissolved. On 5 September 1908 the country reverted to the emblems of the United Provinces of Central America, adopting the present flag with the triangular national arms.

features.role: coat of arms of the Greater Republic of Central America
